base_intent_serialization: JSON ASCII (all strings in provided fixture ASCII and no float); sorted keys, separators=(comma,colon), no LF/BOM. No general RFC8785 claim.

raw_variant_instructions.CANONICAL: Use BASE_INTENT with per-case field overrides; render JSON in sorted-key ASCII, compact, no LF.
raw_variant_instructions.WHITESPACE_INSERTION: Insert one ASCII space after the first colon into an otherwise valid canonical byte string.
raw_variant_instructions.TRAILING_LF: Append a single ASCII LF to the canonical bytes.
raw_variant_instructions.LEADING_BOM: Prepend UTF-8 BOM EF BB BF.
raw_variant_instructions.DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY: Add a second key named context at root without removing the original key; use raw byte insertion.
raw_variant_instructions.UNKNOWN_APPROVED_KEY: Add root approved:true; canonicalize with sorted keys.
raw_variant_instructions.INVALID_UTF8: Insert raw FF byte at the beginning.
raw_variant_instructions.JSON_ARRAY: Return b[] instead of the object.
raw_variant_instructions.RAW_NAN_TOKEN: Replace literal scheduler_step_us:5000 with scheduler_step_us:NaN (nonstandard JSON).
raw_variant_instructions.REVERSED_KEY_ORDER: Reverse root insertion order before serialization, enforce changed raw bytes and identical parsed dict.
raw_variant_instructions.OVERSIZED_4097: Return b space repeated 4097 bytes (over size quota).
raw_variant_instructions.UNKNOWN_SIGNATURE_KEY: Add root signature:"fake"; canonicalize with sorted keys.
raw_variant_instructions.UNKNOWN_TRUSTED_HOST_KEY: Add root trusted_host:true; canonicalize with sorted keys.

byte_variant_instructions.EXACT: Use exact frozen policy raw bytes or exact ASCII test artifact bytes from index.
byte_variant_instructions.FLIP_FIRST: Flip first byte ASCII to Z if first byte is not Z, else to Y.
byte_variant_instructions.TRUNCATE_LAST: Remove final byte; test byte strings are nonempty and remain nonempty.

upstream_e2_instructions.MATCH: Use real TASK-001 accepted minimal wire + TASK-010 reference host claim and canonical policy bytes; assert REFERENCE_MATCH_NO_AUTHORITY and no authority.
upstream_e2_instructions.UPSTREAM_REJECTED: Use real TASK-001 rejected wire with extra approved key, then TASK-010; result UPSTREAM_REJECTED.
upstream_e2_instructions.REFERENCE_MISMATCH: Use real TASK-001 accepted wire but E2 policy bytes with appended LF, then TASK-010; result REFERENCE_MISMATCH.

hash_expression_instruction: =sha256(selected_*_bytes).hexdigest() is a declarative equality marker; compare to actual digest explicitly in test, never eval()

mandatory_negative_test_families.description: N01 exact input classes and bool-as-int, subclasses, malformed E2
N02 input byte caps: 4096 intent and 1048576 each artifact/policy, reject oversize before parse/hash
N03 canonical ASCII-only JSON, sorted ASCII keys, no BOM/whitespace/LF, no invalid UTF-8
N04 duplicate JSON keys, unknown/missing fields and nested/arrays rejected
N05 NaN/Infinity/floats/bools rejected for numeric fields, no json loose parsing
N06 strict lowerhex digest shape; uppercase/short/nonhex rejected as malformed
N07 wrong context/scope/owner/contract/mixer/step/version keys mismatch not upgrade
N08 policy digest equality both declared field and independently supplied policy bytes
N09 engine artifact bytes changed after intent fails; self-described digest is not authenticated identity
N10 scheduler artifact bytes changed after intent fails; revision labels are TEST_ONLY
N11 public caller signature/trusted_host/approved fields rejected, no key usage/secret files
N12 invalid or rejected E2 result short-circuits BEFORE parsing/hashing candidate bytes
N13 syntactically forged E2 match could pass content check but never yield any authority
N14 deterministic ordered tuple reasons; permanent three trust deficits last
N15 frozen nine-field result; constants runtime_authorized false and requires_full_fsm true unmodifiable
N17 no direct E2 mutation or TASK-009/006 adapter, no simulator runner/output creation
N18 dev+wheel smoke, accurate JUnit, provenance hashes, ten prior regressions TASK-001..010 and UAT non-duplicated
